name: How can I make my guest bathroom feel more spacious?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my guest bathroom feel more spacious?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a guest bathroom feel more spacious, consider installing a floating vanity or a pedestal sink to free up floor space. Using large format tiles for both floors and walls can create a seamless look, and a frameless glass shower enclosure minimizes visual barriers. Incorporate ample lighting, including natural light if possible, and use a large mirror to reflect light and expand the perception of space. Lighter color palettes also contribute to an airy feel.
acceptedAnswer.description: To enhance spaciousness in a guest bathroom, use floating vanities, large format tiles, frameless glass showers, ample lighting, and lighter color palettes to create an open, airy feel.
